description: Improve real website and workbench UI through rendered inspection, Host-guided visual and interaction repairs, and same-condition verification.

capabilities: Visual repair workflow for layout, typography, icon proportions, color roles, spacing, imagery and responsive composition; automated measurements require screenshot-based judgement
Host asset handoff: reuse approved assets and vector icon systems; use available built-in image generation for requested bitmap imagery without SVG placeholder substitution
One default run entry with natural-language routing across Diagnose, Focused Repair, Verify-only, Explain, Transformation, and Specialized Audit intents
Real-page UX layer: real-page readiness, PageHealth, safe interaction probes, immutable Before/After conditions, and user-task-first ranking
Governance layer: current-session approval semantics, evidence classes, bounded discovery cache, and capability policy
4.0 Trust/Repair Kernel: sealed baselines, exact patch scope, Host-bound writes/tools, receipts, drift, patch quality, and coverage-gated VERIFIED
Transformation layer: product understanding, 1–3 isolated design directions, Design Gallery, decision workbench, and modernization planning
Risk Tier T0–T4 selects verification strictness without granting authority
Change Budget prevents silent file/config/dependency scope expansion and participates in the final repair gate
Evidence Dependency Graph links Goal, Baseline, Before, Scope, Host Receipt, After, tools, drift, quality, comparison, and final verification
Relevant Context Packet v1 with mandatory Protected Scope and Host-only authority context
40-archetype deterministic repair development corpus and 12 adversarial strategy families / 1200 deterministic benchmark-infrastructure probes
No implicit dependency install, source upload, commit, push, deployment, production-data mutation, or remote-attestation claim
Benchmark Protocol v4 with Controller-planned conditions plus controller-private HMAC-SHA256 authentication for plan/state/ground-truth manifest set
Frozen 8-case obfuscated-root holdout corpus measured diagnostically, never used as a tuned recall release gate
Three-level benchmark oracles: source contracts, executable behavior, and Playwright browser behavior with HTTP/HTTPS blocked during fixture evaluation
Executable oracle process limits and isolated HOME/TMP are disclosed as PROCESS_LIMITED_NOT_OS_ISOLATED; hostile same-user agents still require external OS/container isolation
defaultPrompt: 直接描述目标：检查/点评默认只读；修复/改好进入受控修复与验证；意图不明确时默认只读。
普通项目内已授权修复不重复确认；新增依赖、凭据、项目外写入、生产访问、Git/发布或降低安全隔离必须显式确认。
先解决真实页面的错位、图标比例、配色、空间、图片和交互完成度，再验证结果。需要生成图片时使用可用的内置生图工具；不把占位素材或测试通过当成视觉交付。
interface.longDescription: Web UI Quality helps the Host AI improve real websites and workbenches: layout, icons, typography, color roles, spacing, imagery, responsive composition and complete interactions. It combines rendered measurements with explicit visual judgement, guides authorized source and asset repairs, and checks the result on the real page. Scope and evidence controls support this product-quality loop; they do not substitute for visual finish.
interface.shortDescription: 检查并改好真实页面的排版、图标、配色、空间、图片和交互，修完实际复验。

name: web-ui-quality
